faq.headline: Frequently asked questions.
faq.askLink: Still have a question? Ask us →

items.a: It is the system built to run your business. It can include an internal app, a storefront or a client portal. Every Nexus is different.

items.q: When does the first phase end?
items.a: Before work begins, we sign what it includes, who uses it and when it is done. Later changes are quoted separately.

items.q: What if my team doesn't use it?
items.a: We design it with your team and test it on real cases. One person in your business must own the project.

items.q: What if we build it with AI?
items.a: Do it. Pick one process and get it running with AI. We will do the same. Then compare what works, what your team uses and who maintains it.

items.q: How do I know it will work?
items.a: We sign acceptance criteria. If we miss one that is under our control, we keep working without additional implementation fees.
You pay once for the build and monthly for operations. The price is fixed in writing after the audit.

items.q: What if I want to leave?
items.a: You receive your customers, payments, invoices and history in Excel and reports. The system and code stay with Æther. This is agreed in writing before work begins.
